newsitem.title: FRANCE: ONIC raises wheat, barley export goal to non-EU.
newsitem.headline: ONIC raises wheat, barley export goal to non-EU.

text.p: France's grain office ONIC on Wednesday confirmed it raised by 250,000 tonnes its forecast for soft wheat exports to non-EU countries for the 1996/97 season.
In a new supply/demand report released ahead of ONIC's monthly news conference, the office also raised by 400,000 tonnes its estimate for barley exports to non-EU countries in 1996/97.
ONIC now expects France to export 6.25 million tonnes of soft wheat to non-EU countries in 1996/97 against the 6.0 million forecast previously and the 3.75 million exported in 1995/96.
ONIC also expects France to export 1.5 million tonnes of barley to non-EU states in 1996/97 against 1.1 million tonnes forecast previously and 221,000 tonnes exported in 1995/96.
ONIC raised its target for soft wheat exports to other European Union countries to 9.035 million tonnes from 8.940 million forecast last month and 8.613 million in 1995/96.
It slightly increased its target for barley exports to other EU countries to 2.26 million tonnes from a previous target of 2.20 million tonnes and 2.244 million exported in 1995/96.
The report suggests France would end the 1996/97 season with a soft wheat carryover of 2.185 million tonnes against 2.365 million forecast last month and 2.212 million in 1995/96.
ONIC put the barley carryover at 1.115 million tonnes against 1.375 million last month and 626,000 tonnes at end-June 1996.
